items.quote: 19:20 And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
items.claim: The text says the LORD came down onto the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses up to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
items.action: came down upon the mount; called Moses up; Moses went up
items.mechanism: Narrative statement in a numbered verse (19:20). The document does not name its source. The match to Exodus 19:20 (King James Version) comes from model-prior only and has not been checked. Passes 1 and 2 agreed on this wording apart from punctuation. Pass 3 was empty.
